notes:
Topline: mid-market SaaS product team focused on embedded user workflows and in‑app help. Started with Hosted API PoC (chat + embeddings) in Jan; now evaluating Dedicated/VPC for production due to PII and residency needs.

PoC summary: hosted API trial (2 weeks) -> low friction to integrate; performance acceptable for dev tests but need predictable latency and private networking for prod. They call out cost as 'important but secondary to control & SLAs' — willing to commit to reserved capacity if latency and residency guarantees met.

Security ask (explicit): SOC2 Type II evidence, SSO/SAML for console, audit log streaming to customer SIEM, retention controls for model inputs/outputs (configurable retention windows), KMS integration for key management, and IP allowlist + private egress. Also want model isolation options (no multi-tenant cache sharing).

Quote from Director of Platform (call 2026-02-18): 'We can live with higher token cost if we know the model won't be routed to other customers and we can get 1:1 auditability for requests.'

Commercial: initial ARR target ~ $150-220k, willing to move to $300k+ if Dedicated throughput guarantees + 99.9% uptime SLA. Procurement expects final legal/cyber checklist done before exec sign-off.

poc_plan_and_success_criteria: 4-week Dedicated POC: week 1 - VPC provisioning + SAML SSO test; week 2 - ingest 3M tokens/day test traffic (synthetic) to validate 200ms p95 latency for chat and 40 req/s throughput for embeddings; week 3 - audit log export to customer SIEM + retention policy validation; week 4 - run failover to fallback model and validate routing & cost metrics. Success = p95 latency <= 250ms for 90% of test windows, audit logs captured and queryable, DPA signed.
technical_requirements:
- Latency target: p95 <= 250ms for typical 512-token chat requests.
- Throughput: baseline 40 req/s for embeddings, burst support to 120 req/s.
- Model preferences: open models (quantized Llama-3 family) preferred; allow pinning and fallback smaller family for low-sensitivity tasks.
- Routing: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU for EU-resident data).
- Caching: KV/prefix cache must be configurable per-application; explicit opt-out for sensitive endpoints.
- Observability: token-level cost + latency breakdown in console; ability to stream audit logs to Splunk/Sumo/OCI.
